lanes.name: unit
lanes.description: Vitest frontend tests (tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} minus *.slow.test.*; jsdom by default, node per file per ADR-0049). No external services.

lanes.name: slow
lanes.description: Vitest slow tier (tests/**/*.slow.test.{ts,tsx}): exhaustive, property and cost-enumeration sweeps excluded from the unit lane (ADR-0050). Coverage stays with the unit lane.
lanes.command: scripts/heavy-lock.sh pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.slow.config.ts

lanes.name: rust
lanes.description: cargo test for the Tauri backend: #[cfg(test)] units, tests/render_golden.rs, doc tests. Runs through scripts/cargo-test-lane.mjs, which maps cargo exit 101 to 1 when a `test result: FAILED.` summary was printed (a failing test), so tdd-guardian reads it as fail rather than runner-error; a compile error stays 101.
lanes.command: scripts/heavy-lock.sh node scripts/cargo-test-lane.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

lanes.name: rust-verify-run
lanes.description: cargo test with --features control-channel (ADR-0047 WI-009; the feature implies verify-run): compiles the feature-gated verify_run* and services/control_channel/** modules and their tests, which the plain rust lane never builds. Not a superset of the rust lane: wi6_t01 (shipping MCP port 55045) is feature-off only. Runs through scripts/cargo-test-lane.mjs, which maps cargo exit 101 to 1 when a `test result: FAILED.` summary was printed (a failing test), so tdd-guardian reads it as fail rather than runner-error; a compile error stays 101.
lanes.command: scripts/heavy-lock.sh node scripts/cargo-test-lane.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features control-channel

lanes.name: clippy
lanes.description: cargo clippy --all-targets with -D warnings (D157): every lint is an error, so a new lint from a toolchain update fails the commit gate until it is fixed.

lanes.name: fmt
lanes.description: cargo fmt --check on src-tauri (D167): the tree was formatted once in full, so any unformatted Rust line fails the commit gate. Run `cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` to fix it, but never on a file whose receipt is still unsettled; see docs/reference/20261012-d167-rustfmt-proof.md. Not under heavy-lock: it only parses, finishes in about a second, and is not a heavy command in rule 10's sense.

lanes.name: integration
lanes.description: Real `pnpm control:build --profile verify` smoke (scripts/control/smoke.mjs, ADR-0047): inspects the build manifest, codesign -dvvv cdhash and the absence of updater artifacts in the bundle dir; verify profile only, the release --config path is not exercised.

criticalPaths.description: Link scheme allowlist and app-origin comparison (ADR-0001, ADR-0002). A defect here hands an attacker-chosen URL to the OS opener; measured 34/34 lines and 26/26 branches when pinned.
Sole caller of the link gates; routes every WYSIWYG link click and decides what reaches the OS opener. Measured 67/67 lines and 23/23 branches when pinned.

The heading-key matcher (WI-3.5.2): the only place the `headingKey` coordination contract in src/types/toc.ts is executed. A missed branch here silently hands one heading's collapse/active state to another, which the user cannot see happen.
